程序包 com.ta.recruitment.servlet

类 AdminServlet

javax.servlet.GenericServlet

com.ta.recruitment.servlet.BaseServlet
com.ta.recruitment.servlet.AdminServlet
所有已实现的接口:
Serializable, javax.servlet.Servlet, javax.servlet.ServletConfig
@WebServlet("/admin/*") public class AdminServlet extends BaseServlet
Handles all admin portal requests under /admin/*.

GET routes: user dashboard, job management, job detail, application management, CV download, workload management, workload edit, profile, add-MO form, and user edit page (including per-module approval).

POST routes: job open/close, openings update, application accept/reject/restore, user activate/deactivate, module approve/reject (bulk and per-entry), add-MO form submission, user info / password / module edits, and workload save.
